answers.product: A notes app that turns a messy voice memo into a clean, searchable note.
answers.users: Individuals; the product calls them "the user".
answers.dayOne: Day 1: record one memo and read the clean note. Every day: capture, search, revisit.
answers.designSource: Figma file "Acme Notes v1"; it wins on style and copy.
answers.surfacesNote: Phone-width web first, native fast-follow through Expo; nothing is one-platform on purpose yet.
answers.repo: Standalone repo, no shared packages, no monorepo.
answers.data: Postgres through Prisma, own database. No PHI; ordinary PII (email). Notes kept until the user deletes them.
answers.auth: Email OTP now, Apple and Google later. Cookie on web, header from secure storage on mobile. OTP rate-limited at the controller.
answers.payments: None for launch; revisit after 500 weekly actives.
answers.llm: One provider with failover to a second; streaming for the note view; structured output for the summary; no customer text leaves the building without the provider's zero-retention setting.
answers.analytics: Own event store; first funnel: record → note ready → second session.
answers.hosting: Container on a managed runtime; GitHub Actions; secrets in the host's secret manager; mobile builds through EAS, each paid build needs a per-instance approval.
answers.compliance: GDPR only: export and delete on request.
answers.languages: Code, git and tickets in English; product docs in English.
answers.naming: Trunk is development; release branches releases/vX.Y.Z; port base 3000/5173/8300.
answers.workingStyle: Defaults accepted: small undoable steps, mock-first, proof proportional to the change, no git writes unless asked. Pre-seed the 7 company roles + 3 engineering roles; hire the rest on demand.
